_README: Row-level corrections arising from the adversarial verification pass (see coagulopathy.md). Applied by build_dataset.py. Each entry is matched on a NATURAL key -- source_id plus readout_name plus the printed readout_value -- not on measurement_id, because measurement_ids are positional and would silently retarget if the input ever changed. A key that does not match is reported by the build and applied to nothing; corrections fail closed.
